changeSet.author: alfcheun
changeSet.comment: Name every strategy for the cadence it was fitted on
changeSet.sql:
-- 1.18.0-001 is the precondition. Fail loud rather than skip rows. DO $$ BEGIN IF EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM BT.STRATEGY WHERE NOT JSONB_EXISTS(CONFIG_JSON, 'tm_interval_id') ) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'BT.STRATEGY rows without CONFIG_JSON.tm_interval_id — run 1.18.0-001 first'; END IF; END $$;
-- Insert `:CADENCE` ahead of the arrow, recording what these runs -- always were. Scoped to names already in the `TRADE@VENUE` shape: -- rows predating that change are a lineage nothing enqueues into -- any more, and rewriting them would assert a history they do not -- have. Idempotent — a name already carrying a cadence is skipped. UPDATE BT.STRATEGY s SET STRATEGY_NM = OVERLAY( s.STRATEGY_NM PLACING ':' || ti.NAME FROM POSITION(' ← ' IN s.STRATEGY_NM) FOR 0 ) FROM REFDATA.TM_INTERVAL ti WHERE ti.TM_INTERVAL_ID = (s.CONFIG_JSON->>'tm_interval_id')::INTEGER AND POSITION(' ← ' IN s.STRATEGY_NM) > 0 AND POSITION('@' IN SUBSTRING(s.STRATEGY_NM FROM 1 FOR POSITION(' ← ' IN s.STRATEGY_NM))) > 0 AND POSITION(':' IN SUBSTRING(s.STRATEGY_NM FROM 1 FOR POSITION(' ← ' IN s.STRATEGY_NM))) = 0;

changeSet.author: alfcheun
changeSet.comment: Move rows fitted on a cadence their lineage does not own into their own STRATEGY_ID
